title: Casamajor Car-nage
hud_description: Blow up <col: Yellow>3</col> enemy vehicles.
long_description: Enforcers think they're all safe, tucked up in their little cars. Could you, um, prove that they're not? Just <col: Yellow>blow up three enemy vehicles</col> they don't even need to be in them just... make them go away.

title: Vroom Vroom Boom
hud_description: Blow up <col: Yellow>3</col> enemy vehicles.
long_description: Criminals think that there is honor to be found in hiding behind armor plated vehicles. <col: Yellow>Destroy three enemy vehicles</col> and show them not to hide. Prevent them from being able to flee like the rats they are.

title: Filler Piece
hud_description: Complete <col: Yellow>5</col> objectives.
long_description: I need some footage for my show tonight, 211 in Progress. Can you get out there and make some noise? I don't want footage of you getting carried away in an ambulance or something so get out there and <col: Yellow>complete five objectives,</col> okay?

title: Win by the Inches
hud_description: Complete or Assist <col: Yellow>5</col> objectives.
long_description: Hey, shug. We've got to keep the scoreboard in mind so could you get out there and <col: Yellow>complete five objectives?</col> I don't need to see it all in one go or anything, I just need someone to meet the quota's for the day, okay?

title: Supply Lines Open
hud_description: Resupply <col: Yellow>25</col> magazines to teammates.
long_description: Heyyyy. Double B keeps bragging about how many Suppliers she gives out. Use your <col: Yellow>Field Supplier</col> to <col: Yellow>resupply your teammates</col> 25 times today. We'll show her that no one cares if you're just giving it away, it only matters if they know how to work it.

title: Water Boy for Guns
hud_description: Resupply <col: Yellow>25</col> magazines to teammates.
long_description: Hey, Broseph. Gotta teach you about humility. You're gonna become your teams water boy. There's nothin' wrong with making sure that your teammates are well stocked with ammo so <col: Yellow>resupply 25 of your teammates</col> with your <col: Yellow>field supplier.</col>

title: Lead Poisoning
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>5</col> enemies.
long_description: Some Enforcer posers were rolling around Prentiss like they owned the place. Could you be a lamb and send a message? <col: Yellow>Kill 5 Enforcers</col> just to send a message.

title: Meat and Potatoes
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>5</col> enemies.
long_description: Hey. Put your best boots on, it's time to kick someone's shit in. Get out there and kill <col: Yellow>5</col> Criminals.

title: Like Lightning
hud_description: Earn <col: Yellow>1</col> Blitzkrieg medals.
long_description: You wanna do something cool? <col: Yellow>Blitzkrieg 2 Enforcers</col> for me. 2 kills in five seconds. Get in there and hit them like a bolt of lightning!

title: Make ‘em Count
hud_description: Earn <col: Yellow>1</col> Blitzkrieg medals.
long_description: I want you to prove that you're not just tough but quick too. <col: Yellow>Blitzkrieg 2 Criminals.</col> That means kill 2 Criminals in five seconds. You got it in you, champ?

title: Beta Testing
hud_description: Win <col: Yellow>2</col> missions.
long_description: Dude. My beta waves are flagging, can you get out there and do something to keep them from going all theta on me? <col: Yellow>Win two missions</col> and send me a message? Thanks. Now, I need some coffee.

title: Satisfied Customers
hud_description: Win <col: Yellow>2</col> missions.
long_description: Hey hon. We need a little bit of a PR victory. Nothing major, yeah? Just a little something to show that all the money we're pumping into Havalynd is worth pumping. Get out there and <col: Yellow>win 2 missions</col> and report back. Ciao.

title: Like a Clown Car
hud_description: Have <col: Yellow>3</col> players spawn in your vehicle.
long_description: You ever see a clown car? No? Get a vehicle with  <col: Yellow>Mobile Spawn Point</col> and have <col: Yellow>3 players</col> spawn in your vehicle. See? It's a clown car.

title: A Red Carpet Moment
hud_description: Have <col: Yellow>3</col> players spawn in your vehicle.
long_description: You wanna know the best feeling? Getting out of a limo at the red carpet and having your people follow you. Makes you feel like you've arrived, babe! Get <col: Yellow>3 Players</col> to <col: Yellow>spawn in your vehicle.</col>

title: Seeing Red
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>4<col> enemies with your shotgun.
long_description: Enforcers are rolling up on my shit. Get out there, pull a <col: Yellow>shotgun</col> on them turn <col: Yellow>4<col> of those fuckers into a fine red mist. Up close and personal, like.

title: CQB Weapons Training
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>4<col> enemies with a shotgun.
long_description: Variety is the spice of life. It's important to keep your options open and I wanna see what you can do when you get close enough to see their pupils dilate the moment they hear you pull the trigger. Grab a <col: Yellow>shotgun and kill 4 Criminals.</col>

title: Assault Rifle Training
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>5</col> enemies with an assault rifle.
long_description: Got something nice and simple for you right now. I need you to <col: Yellow>kill 5 Enforcers with assault rifles.</col> Nice and simple, but it keeps the balance sheet straight. Not glamorous, I know, but I get a feeling you'll enjoy it anyway.

title: Mirri's Meltdown
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>5</col> enemies with an assault rifle.
long_description: Mirri's havin' a 'moment,' which means she's about to meltdown over a lack of clean kills recently. Can you help me build up her Zen? Get out there and <col: Yellow>kill 5 Criminals with assault rifles?</col> Just make it clean and simple.

title: But This One Is Mine
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>5</col> enemies with Marksman weapons.
long_description: Bonita gets to spend her time at dinner parties and with her flavor of the month boyfriend and I get to help out on the streets and actually doing shit that's useful. How about you make yourself useful for me? <col: Yellow>Kill 5 Enforcers</col> with a rifle.

title: Knock Off Knock Out
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>5</col> enemies with Marksman weapons.
long_description: Criminals have a new shipment of cheap knock off rifles from some Eurasian country. Where the fuck is Eurasia? Is that near, like, Russia or something? Fuck it, get out there and <col: Yellow>5 Criminals with a rifle.</col> Fuckin’ poors and their off brand shit.

title: Kill More Enforcers
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>3</col> enemies with your secondary.
long_description: It's kind of a thing for us to kill Enforcers. So how about you get the fuck out there, <col: Yellow>kill 3 Enforcers with your secondary weapon</col> and then give yourself a nice pat on the back for doing such a good job...

title: Street Justice
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>3</col> enemies with your secondary.
long_description: Back when I was a cop I used to love my revolver. See, everyone else on the force had an SNR but I had an RSA. That thing could blow a guy's knee wide open if they weren't feeling talkative. I want you to <col: Yellow>kill 3 Criminals with a secondary.</col>

title: How Very Alarming!
hud_description: Run over <col: Yellow>2</col> enemies with your vehicle.
long_description: Nothing like the sound of a body hitting the bumper to wake you up in the morning. Hey, can you record the noise of <col: Yellow>2 Enforcers getting run down</col> for me? I need something to get me up in the morning and I've been told to lay off the coffee.

title: Handbrake Heartbreak
hud_description: Run over <col: Yellow>2</col> enemies with your vehicle.
long_description: On a battlefield the most important six inches is between your ears. Think about things, stay on your toes and improvise when needed. Before the end of the day, I want you to <col: Yellow>run down 2 Criminals</col> in your vehicle.

title: Take a Dump
hud_description: Deliver <col: Yellow>5</col> Dump Truck's to a Chop Shop.
long_description: Alright, bawbag? Job in Waterfront needs something a bit heavier. Get out there, nick <col: Yellow>5 dump truck's</col> and hand them in to a <col: Yellow>chop shop</col> for shipping around the city. Cheers, pal.

title: Grade A Security
hud_description: Deliver <col: Yellow>5</col> Security Van's to a Chop Shop.
long_description: Alright, bawjaws? Gwan do your ol' pal Grayson a solid? I owe money to the sort of people that you don't wanna owe a pint tae. Can you lift <col: Yellow>5 Security Vans</col> and drop them off at a <col: Yellow> chop shop</col> for me? Magic.

title: False Economy
hud_description: Deliver <col: Yellow>5</col> Taxi's to a Chop Shop.
long_description: Alright, numpty bollocks? We've got a front that runs taxi’s but someone keeps stealing all our cabs. Can you get out there and steal <col: Yellow>5 taxi's and bring them to a chop shop?</col> I can’t believe people keep stealing our taxi's, five at a time...

title: TV Fort
hud_description: Deliver <col: Yellow>5</col> TV's to a fence.
long_description: I'm building a TV fort. It's exactly what it sounds like. Get out there and <col: Yellow>deliver 5 TV's</col> to me. Even the best of forts started small but between you and every other freak out there, I'll have enough for a scale replica of Forche Bank.

title: Small Theft Auto
hud_description: Deliver <col: Yellow>8</col> vehicles to a Chop Shop.
long_description: Scrap metal's huge in China right now. I wanna test the waters with the market. Get out there and <col: Yellow>steal and drop-off 8 cars</col> for me to ship over there as scrap. I'm sure once we file off the numbers under the hood no one'll care.

title: Like a Gelding Knife
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>1</col> Prestige five Enforcer.
long_description: I want you to be the gelding knife to some Enforcers dream of being the big, swinging dick in the district. <col: Yellow>Kill a Prestige 5 Enforcer</col> for me. Send pics.

title: Shock and Awe
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>1</col> Notoriety five Criminal.
long_description: We're going to try and new tack for a moment. <col: Yellow>Kill a notoriety 5 Criminal.</col> Cut off the head of the snake and the body will die soon after. Mmhm, I don't think it'll work either but it's worth a shot.

title: Skint
hud_description: Gather a <col: Yellow>$1000</col> stash.
long_description: I'm as skint as a snow shoveller in July. Can you <col: Yellow>grab a stash of $1000</col>  for me? Ta.

title: Don't Ask Why
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>150</col> pedestrians.
long_description: Hey can you <col: Yellow>murder 150 pedestrians,</col> film it with a camera and give me the film? I need it for reasons. Don't do more than a hundred and fifty though... any more or less and I can't- you know what? Never mind. Just mow the fuckers down.

title: Lost and Found
hud_description: Recover <col: Yellow>3</col> stolen vehicles.
long_description: Can you <col: Yellow>recover 3 vehicles</col> that have been stolen by Criminal's? We need to start returning some of these things to their owners or every insurance broker in the city is going to go bust...

title: Winning Witness
hud_description: Win <col: Yellow>$350</col> worth of witness missions.
long_description: I'm getting tired of Criminal's getting away with stealing everything that's not nailed down and handing it in. <col: Yellow>Win $350 worth of Witness missions</col> and get their stash back to the original owners.

title: Totes Legit
hud_description: Witness <col: Yellow>1</col> Criminal.
long_description: <col: Yellow>Witness a Criminal</col> doing something illegal. This shouldn't be difficult, especially in this city.

title: Take Them Alive
hud_description: Arrest <col: Yellow>1</col> Criminal.
long_description: I need you to take a Criminal alive. We think that they're planning something and we want as much information about it before it happens so <col: Yellow>arrest 1 Criminal</col> and we'll take it from there. Thank you.

title: Fall Down, Go Boom
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>3</col> Enforcers with grenades.
long_description: I'm a big fan of grenades. I'm making a frag video in honor of my favorite type and need some footage. <col: Yellow>Grenade kill 3 Enforcers.</col> Doesn't have to be all at once and can be with any kind of grenade, I just need some footage.

title: Ninja Smoke Bomb!
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>3</col> Criminals with grenades.
long_description: I've heard stories of people around the city pretending to be ninja. They throw a grenade at their feet and their enemies disappear. Disgusting. Ninja should not be emulated. <col: Yellow>Kill 3 Criminals with grenades</col> and show proper use.

title: Size Matters
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>3</col> Enforcers with Light Machine Guns.
long_description: Light Machine Gun's aren't really all that delicate. Then again, I suppose sometimes all you really want from life is a great, big weapon huh? Get out there and <col: Yellow>kill 3 Enforcers with a Light Machine Gun.</col>

title: Suppressed Rage
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>3</col> Criminals with Light Machine Guns.
long_description: One of the most important things to understand on the battlefield is when to change up your role. LMG's, for example, can be for suppression and direct fire. Try it out. <col: Yellow>Kill 3 Criminals with an LMG.</col>

title: Something Stylish
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>5</col> Enforcers with Sub Machine Guns.
long_description: I'm thinking of switching my pistol for an SMG. I'm just worried that I might not have the firepower needed to get from the club to the hotel and back again in one piece. Can you demo an SMG for me? Just <col: Yellow>kill 5 Enforcers with an SMG.</col>

title: A Tigers Claw
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>5</col> Criminals with Sub Machine Guns.
long_description: Hey! Get your claws out, tiger! There's Criminal's that need lead poisoning. Grab a <col: Yellow>sub machine gun and kill 5 Criminals</col> for me.

title: Most Valuable G-King
hud_description: Be MVP <col:yellow>Once.</col>
long_description: The G-Kings are expanding. We're looking for brave men and women to take the lead in our community. We need people that are valuable to both the organization and to individual operations. <col: Yellow>Become MVP once</col> and we'll see if you’re a leader.

title: Most Valuable 'Torian
hud_description: Be MVP <col:yellow>Once.</col>
long_description: I value results more than anyone else you'll ever meet. I want people that can turn a failure into a success. I'm not sure I want you, though. Convince me. <col: Yellow>Become MVP once</col> and we'll talk more.

title: Most Valuable Tiger
hud_description: Be MVP <col:yellow>Once.</col>
long_description: Some people call the Tigers elitist pricks. They're right. We are. Most people just aren't good enough to be in the Tigers, or in Prentiss for that matter. If you <col: Yellow>win MVP once</col> we'll talk more about taking you more serious in future.

title: Most Valuable 'Rose
hud_description: Be MVP <col:yellow>Once.</col>
long_description: In my organization there's only one thing that matters: Results. It's the results that matter.  Prove that you're the best and we'll talk more. Go win a match and <col: Yellow>be MVP once.</col>

title: Bloodrose Business
hud_description: Be MVP <col:yellow>Once.</col>
long_description: Business is slower than usual and Simeone has requested that you do what you can to change that. <col: Yellow>Become MVP once</col> and show the streets of Waterfront who's really in charge of this place.

title: Tiger Territory
hud_description: Be MVP <col:yellow>Once.</col>
long_description: You've been doing well out there! We're seeing less and less gang activity on our streets. Keep it that way and <col: Yellow>Become MVP once</col> to show the Criminal scum who really runs things on the 'front.

title: Nothing Personal
hud_description: Reach a Kill Streak of <col: Yellow>15.</col>
long_description: It’s just business. Go out, <col: Yellow>kill 15 Enforcers in a streak</col> for a reward. It’s nothing personal.

title: Big Data
hud_description: Reach a Kill Streak of <col: Yellow>15.</col>
long_description: Big data is information that’s so huge in complexity that you can’t process it by traditional means. I've been looking into it and the Praetorians are generating interesting values. <col: Yellow>Kill 15 Criminals in a streak.</col> Let’s make a statistical anomaly.

title: Be A Winner!
hud_description: Reach a Kill Streak of <col: Yellow>15.</col>
long_description: Get your game face on, bitch! Get out there, stamp on someone’s fuckin’ throat, pound a beer and fuck their girlfriend! Before ya do, though, <col: Yellow>kill 15 Criminals in a streak!</col> Be a fucking WINNER!

title: Like You Mean It
hud_description: Reach a Kill Streak of <col: Yellow>15.</col>
long_description: You'll have noticed by now that some think the Blood Roses are a poser teenagers, annoyed at their precious, carefree lives. Emo vampire role-players gone feral. Prove them wrong. <col: Yellow>Kill 15 Enforcers in a streak<col> for me. That'll send a message.

title: Celebrity Status
hud_description: Get MVP <col: Yellow>3</col> in a row.
long_description: Probably the best way to become famous is by being good at something - the easiest way is with a sextape and I don't think you're cut out for that. <col: Yellow>Earn MVP 3 times in a streak</col> and you'll get on the Effigy front cover.

title: Consistency Counts
hud_description: Get MVP <col: Yellow>3</col> in a row.
long_description: Some floor trader was on his phone, talking about his latest trade. It sounded like a short term win that'd lose in the long run. Are you a good long term investment? Let's see. <col: Yellow>Win MVP 3 times in a row</col> and we'll see.

title: Be The Best
hud_description: Get MVP <col: Yellow>3</col> in a row.
long_description: You win the cup once and people think it's a fluke. You win the cup twice and people think that you're onto something. You win the cup three times? People think you're the best. <col: Yellow>Win MVP in a mission 3 times in a row</col> and prove who you are.

title: Soft Power
hud_description: Get MVP <col: Yellow>3</col> in a row.
long_description: Having a rep really helps. Walking into a place, giving a look, and having them hand over their protection money’s perfect. That's what we called 'soft power.' I wanna build you up like that. <col: Yellow>Get MVP 3 times in a row</col> for me.

title: Office Politics
hud_description: Win <col:yellow>5</col> missions in a row.
long_description: I need someone to show the naysayers that we're capable of winning and capable of doing it repeatedly. <col: Yellow>Win 5 missions in a row</col> to give me some ammo in the board room and help me shut them up.

title: High Performers
hud_description: Win <col:yellow>5</col> missions in a row.
long_description: I have a selection of high profile operatives in my portfolio. I'm thinking of expanding said portfolio. <col: Yellow>Win 5 missions in a row</col> and we'll see about advancing your status in the… portfolio.

title: The Only Thing
hud_description: Win <col:yellow>5</col> missions in a row.
long_description: You know who I hate? People that say 'they tried' when they lose. Fuck those people. Winners never quit. <col: Yellow>Win 5 Missions in a streak,</col> find a loser, punch them in fuckin' face, spit on them and then win some more!

title: A Real Earner
hud_description: Win <col:yellow>5</col> missions in a row.
long_description: The best people are the ones that work and earn. I think you're someone that I can depend on, but I need proof. <col: Yellow>Get out there and win 5 missions in a row</col> and we'll talk about a reward.

title: Old School Kicks
hud_description: Achieve a Kill Streak of <col: Yellow>5.</col>
long_description: For all my talk of being a businessman there's always one thing that it comes back to: the bread and butter of putting people on the ground. <col: Yellow>Hit a kill streak of 5.</col>

title: Hitman
hud_description: Achieve a Kill Streak of <col: Yellow>5.</col>
long_description: We have teams that just walk into a room and start killing. Retribution Squads. We get headlines and we get a hit. Let's see if you have the stomach for it. <col: Yellow>Hit a streak of 5 kills</col> and we'll talk about moving you up off a street team.

title: Down But Not Out
hud_description: Achieve a Kill Streak of <col: Yellow>5.</col>
long_description: We're being pushed back go even out the numbers. <col: Yellow>Hit a kill streak of 5.</col>

title: Make the Conversion
hud_description: Achieve a Kill Streak of <col: Yellow>5.</col>
long_description: Hitting checkpoints and objectives is great and all, but I'd like to see more bodies hitting more floors, you know? <col: Yellow>Hit a kill streak of 5.</col> I like you, so try not to get your ass shot, cool?

title: Balance the Books
hud_description: Achieve a Kill Streak of <col: Yellow>5.</col>
long_description: More Praetorians are getting killed than are killing. Change that. <col: Yellow>hit a kill streak of 5.</col>

title: Continued Assault
hud_description: Achieve a Kill Streak of <col: Yellow>5.</col>
long_description: Keep the pressure up and make sure we stay on top of them. <col: Yellow>Hit a kill streak of 5.</col>

title: aaaag static
hud_description: fuq wi <col: Yellow>5</col> Enforcers radarz.
long_description: oi. Cud u use ur <col: Yellow>radar jammer</col> on sum Enforvers. <col: Yellow>5 shud do.</col>

title: Feel Like Jammin'
hud_description: Jam <col: Yellow>5</col> Criminals.
long_description: As a sniper you shouldn’t be getting close enough for them to spot you but sometimes you can’t help it. Equip your <col: Yellow>radar jammer and jam 5 enemies radar.</col> Seriously, no one sees it coming. It's hilarious.

title: Paparazzi
hud_description: Spot <col: Yellow>5</col> Enforcers.
long_description: Gettin' real mad at the paparazzi that keep stealing pictures of Bonita and I. Can you show them how it feels? <col:yellow>Spot 5 Enforcers</col> and we'll see about getting their pictures up on SPiN.

title: Tactical Feedback
hud_description: Spot <col: Yellow>5</col> Criminals.
long_description: Tactical information requested. Investigate Criminals operating in your AO. <col: Yellow>Spot 5 Criminals</col> using your spotter mod.

title: get to da choppah
hud_description: tag <col: Yellow>10</col> forcerz. Ez du it nau.
long_description: i wunt u 2 tag some enofacorcers. <col: Yellow>10ll do.</col>

title: The Other Kind of Tag
hud_description: Tag <col: Yellow>10</col> Criminals.
long_description: A sniper can't be expected to do everything themselves which means, occasionally, we need a little bit of help. That's where Tagger comes in. It marks people for execution at long range. <col:yellow>Go tag 10 Criminals with Tagger.</col>

title: bit of bangin
hud_description: kabow <col: Yellow>5</col> Enforcers with explosive gunz.
long_description: srsly i dunno wut u wnt me 2 write. take a fing that goes like a rockit, get some derren types and blow em tha fuq uppppppppp. <col: Yellow>u herd. blow up 5 Enforcerz.</col>

title: Heavy Ordinance
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>5</col> Criminals with Demolition weapons.
long_description: Oh hey, I get it. Because I'm a big guy, I have to be the one with the rocket and grenade launchers? How creative of you. <col: Yellow>Kill 5 Criminals with explosive weapons.</col> Not grenades, just rocket launchers and grenade launchers.

title: Keep It Clean
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>8</col>Enforcers with a Sniper Rifle.
long_description: Hey, I can't be seen to be getting my hands dirty. Can you <col: Yellow>kill 8 Enforcers with Sniper Rifles</col> for me please? I'll just... take your word for it that it's done.

title: SPORTS CLICHES!
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>8</col> Criminals with a Sniper Rifle.
long_description: Hey! Put on your game face, get some war paint on and do some other really cliché jock shit. Look, I don't give a fuck? Daddy's tired and wants to see you <col: Yellow>kill 8 Criminals with a Sniper Rifle.</col> Now fuck off before my hangover turns violent.

title: Babysitting
hud_description: Complete <col: Yellow>1</col> Mission.
long_description: I keep getting brought in to do all this baby sitting. Mobile Spawners and field Suppliers won't deliver themselves, you know? Go <col: Yellow>complete a mission</col> and you'll get a reward. Doesn't matter if you win or lose, just so long as you finish.

title: First Steps
hud_description: Complete <col: Yellow>1</col> Mission.
long_description: You'll never progress if you don't finish missions. <col: Yellow>Finish a mission</col> and I'll give you a reward. Doesn't matter if you win or lose, just that you finish. Now, get out of here.

title: snubscription is ded
hud_description: kill <col: Yellow>25</col> doods w a snub nose. lol.
long_description: I keep herin about how snubscription is ded as a payment model. Itz not ded, itz just restin. <col: Yellow>Kill 25 Enforcers</col> w ur snubby.

title: Up Close And Personal
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>25</col> Criminals with a Snub Nose Revolver
long_description: I keep tellin’ people that I can fuck them up if they get close too. I can use a SNR to kill twenty guys before lunch. See if you can do better. <col: Yellow>Kill 25 Criminals</col> with a <col: Yellow>Snub Nose Revolver.</col>

title: Humiliation
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>25</col> Criminals with a Snub Nose Revolver
long_description: Humiliating and enemy is almost as important as killing them. You've got to show his buddies that you're not above rubbing salt into the wounds. <col: Yellow>Kill 25 Criminals</col> with a <col: Yellow>Snub Nose Revolver.</col>

title: It's Cute!
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>25</col> Enforcers with a Snub Nose Revolver
long_description: I'm working on a designer pistol. Just something cute and sexy. Thing is it's gotta be practical as well as stylish. <col:Yellow>Kill 25 Enforcers</col> with a <col:Yellow>Snub Nose Revolver</col> for me as a field test.

title: Not the Done Thing
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>15</col> Enforcers.
long_description: I know it is not the done thing, to ask something of a friend you know for only two weeks in a year but I would ask of you that you <col: Yellow>wreak bloody violence</col> upon <col: Yellow>15 Enforcers.</col> I'll try and make it worth your while, hm?

title: Wages of Sin
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>15</col> Criminals.
long_description: Kill <col: Yellow>15</col> Criminals. Doesn't matter how you do it, just so long as you get it done. Give the reaper somethin' to do.

title: Glory Awaits
hud_description: Complete <col: Yellow>5</col> Missions.
long_description: Let me begin by saying, I don't even require victory from you for this. I am very magnanimous like that, am I not? I simply require of you to <col: Yellow> Complete 5 Missions.</col> No matter if you win or lose. It's the taking part that counts, you little hellion.

title: Lost the Will to Live
hud_description: Complete <col: Yellow>5</col> Missions.
long_description: You ever wanted something to be over so much that you don't care how it ends? Remember that TV show with the magic island? Yeah, my entire life is like that. Gimme some closure. <col: Yellow>Complete 5 Missions.</col> You don't even have to win them.

title: Slayer
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>5</col> Enforcers with a Snub Nose Revolver.
long_description: People say time is the fire in which we burn and that the greatest slayer of man is the simple passing of the hours. Clearly these people never met you. <col: Yellow>Kill 5 Enforcers</col> with a <col: Yellow>Snub Nose Revolver.</col>

title: Pop Gun Fun
hud_description: Kill <col: Yellow>5</col> Criminals with a Snub Nose Revolver.
